info.title: OpenBot public Bot API
info.description: API-02. Bearer tokens use API-01 explicit scopes intersected with current creator membership and independent Bot ACLs. Every operation rechecks current token validity and scope in its resource transaction before commit. Provider credentials, private memory, storage keys and encryption internals are never part of this contract. No group or deferred lifecycle endpoints are included.

get.description: List visible Bots in the token workspace, ordered by canonical Bot UUID ascending. Excludes soft-deleted Bots and includes archived Bots. after is exclusive; nextAfter is null when there are no further visible results. Unknown query fields are rejected. Token workspace and creator are authoritative; clients cannot select another actor or workspace.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, expired or no longer authorized API token.

403.description: The explicit token scope or current Bot authority is insufficient.

503.description: The operation could not be completed. Inspect current state before retrying an unknown mutation outcome.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive canonical Bot UUID cursor. Uppercase input is canonicalized.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Positive decimal integer. Duplicate query fields are rejected.

post.description: Create an active private Bot and version 1, with the token creator as its owner. Omitted limits receive UI defaults: 32768 tokens, 300 seconds, 8 turns and depth 2. Unknown query fields are rejected. Token workspace and creator are authoritative; clients cannot select another actor or workspace.

patch.description: Append configuration using current-version compare-and-swap. Current editor or owner authority is required. Omitted fields and avatar references are preserved. An effective no-op returns the existing version. An explicit model selection checks the token creator's current provider authority. Unknown query fields are rejected. Token workspace and creator are authoritative; clients cannot select another actor or workspace.

get.description: List immutable version metadata, newest first, for a current direct Bot user, editor or owner. before is an exclusive version number. nextBefore is null at the end. Unknown query fields are rejected. Token workspace and creator are authoritative; clients cannot select another actor or workspace.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, expired or no longer authorized API token.

403.description: The explicit token scope or current Bot authority is insufficient.

503.description: The operation could not be completed. Inspect current state before retrying an unknown mutation outcome.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Exclusive version number, encoded as a positive decimal integer.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Positive decimal integer. Duplicate query fields are rejected.

post.description: Archive through the existing Bot lifecycle operation. Current Bot owner authority is required. Preserves configuration/history/avatar references and blocks fresh use. Repeated archive is idempotent; a soft-deleted Bot returns conflict. The request must have no body. Unknown query fields are rejected. Token workspace and creator are authoritative; clients cannot select another actor or workspace.
